context: A student asks an officer about a civil-service career
purpose: Discuss a career; teach 公務員/把握/自民党/趣旨/児童/又は/見解/連合

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 公務員になるには、どうすればいいですか？
lines.en: How do I become a civil servant?
lines.style: earnest teen seeking guidance, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 試験に合格し、業務を把握する努力が必要です。
lines.en: Pass the exam and work to grasp the duties.
lines.style: measured officer giving straight advice, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 自民党とか、政治と関わるんですか？
lines.en: Do you get involved with parties like the LDP?
lines.style: curious teen checking a worry, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 公務員は中立です。政策の趣旨に従って働きます。
lines.en: Civil servants are neutral; we serve the policy’s intent.
lines.style: officer clarifying the principle, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 児童福祉の窓口にも配属されますか？
lines.en: Could I be assigned to a child-welfare desk?
lines.style: teen exploring the roles, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: ええ、福祉又は税務など、幅広い部署があります。
lines.en: Yes, there are wide departments — welfare or tax, etc.
lines.style: officer outlining the breadth, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 上司の見解と違うときは、どうするんですか？
lines.en: What if you differ from a superior’s view?
lines.style: thoughtful teen probing a dilemma, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 組織内の連合的な調整で、合意を目指します。
lines.en: We seek consensus through coordinated alignment within.
lines.style: officer explaining the resolution, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence
